claims.assertion: Gosia says ethical judgments among species depend on cultural perspectives and conflicting interests; what seems harmful to humans may be viewed differently elsewhere.
claims.speaker: Gosia

claims.assertion: Gosia says the Federation permits some conflicts to encourage human spiritual and mental development, though this can appear cruel from Earth’s perspective.
claims.speaker: Gosia
claims.qualifiers: She attributes this rationale to off-world accounts.

claims.assertion: Gosia describes many star cultures as benevolent, but says regressive Reptilian, Draco, and Grey factions covertly exploit humans; she cautions that not all Reptilians or Greys are negative.
claims.speaker: Gosia

coverage_gaps: Passive and semiregressive groups and details about astral entities omitted
